items.title: Carney says Alberta is 'essential' to Canada as province plans vote on separation

items.summary_zh: 艾伯塔宣布将就是否应该留在加拿大或就分离问题举行有约束力的投票举行公投后一日,马克·卡尼总理称西部省份是该国"基本"的一部分.

items.summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin has promised retaliation after accusing Ukraine of carrying out a deadly attack on a student dormitory in an occupied part of eastern Ukraine.
items.summary_zh: 俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京在指责乌克兰对乌克兰东部被占领地区的一所学生宿舍进行致命袭击后,承诺报复.

items.title: Trump is putting pressure on Cuba - why and to what end?

items.summary_zh: 一名在马尔代夫找回了意大利潜水员尸体的潜水队成员说,他们发现的装备"并不理想".

items.summary: The public health risk from the current Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has been raised from "high" to "very high" by the World Health Organization (WHO).

items.title: Waymo pauses robotaxis in five US cities after cars drive into flooded roads

items.summary_zh: 阿丽娜·萨巴伦卡一直是球员与四大斯莱姆联赛争议中的声优人物.

items.summary_zh: 在印度,每年有上千名年轻妇女因嫁妆不足而被谋杀,嫁妆不足的死亡很少成为新闻。

items.title: AI used to fake evidence that ended Korean actor's career, say police
items.title_zh: AI曾经伪造证据 结束了韩国演员的职业生涯,说警察
items.summary: South Korean police are seeking an arrest warrant for a YouTuber who allegedly faked evidence that defamed actor Kim Soo-hyun and fuelled a scandal which ended his career.
items.summary_zh: 韩国警方正在寻找对一名YouTuber的逮捕令,据称他伪造了诽谤演员金秀贤的证据并煽动了一场结束他职业生涯的丑闻。

items.summary_zh: BBC的"华尔街"的米歇尔·弗洛里(Michelle Fleury)报道了近期的政府备案,显示今年头三个月,有上千个股票市场交易是代表唐纳德·特朗普总统进行的.

items.title: Timelapse footage shows 'giant cave' inflating on Paris bridge

items.summary_zh: Timlelapse镜头显示巴黎最古老的桥梁一夜之间被改造为巨大的充气地洞结构.

items.title: Slow Food founder Carlo Petrini dies aged 76
items.title_zh: 减速食品创始人Carlo Petrini已逝世,享年76岁
items.summary: Slow Food pioneer Carlo Petrini, who spent four decades promoting sustainable food production and traditional cooking, has died aged 76 in his Italian hometown.
items.summary_zh: 缓慢的食物先驱卡洛·佩特里尼(Carlo Petrini)花了40年时间促进可持续的粮食生产和传统烹饪,他已经在意大利的家乡去世了,享年76岁.

items.title: 'No means no': Greenlanders protest against Trump outside new US consulate
items.title_zh: 格陵兰人在美国新领事馆外抗议特朗普,
items.summary: Hundreds of Greenlanders gathered outside a new American consulate in the capital Nuuk on Friday to protest against Donald Trump's ambition for greater influence over the island.
items.summary_zh: 数百名格陵兰人星期五聚集在首都努克的一个新的美国领事馆外,抗议唐纳德·特朗普对该岛施加更大影响力的野心.

items.title: Fans react to Stephen Colbert’s final show
items.title_zh: 粉丝们对Stephen Colbert最后的节目的反应
items.summary: Fans lined up outside the Ed Sullivan Theater one last time for “The Late Show” as Stephen Colbert prepared to host his final episode, marking the end of the franchise’s 33-year run on CBS. The network announced last summer that the show would end, calling it “purely a financial decision against a challenging backdrop in late night". Colbert took on the show in September 2015 after David Letterman retired from the role he'd held for 22 years.
items.summary_zh: 粉丝们在爱德·沙利文剧院外排队, 最后一次参加“后期秀”的演出, 电视网去年夏天宣布节目会结束,称其为"在深夜充满挑战的背景下纯粹是财务决定". 2015年9月,在大卫·莱特曼从他担任了22年的角色退休后,科尔伯特接演了该节目.

items.title: How Cuban-Americans feel about Raúl Castro's indictment
items.title_zh: 古巴裔美国人对劳尔·卡斯特罗的起诉有何感想?
items.summary: Cuban-Americans in Miami are looking at the US indictment issued against Cuba's former president Raúl Castro with hope but also trepidation. A similar course of events took place with Venezuelan leader Nicolas Maduro before his capture by US forces in January.
items.summary_zh: 迈阿密的古巴裔美国人满怀希望, 在委内瑞拉领导人尼古拉斯·马杜罗于一月被美军俘虏之前,发生了类似的事件。

items.title: Iran steps up claim to control Strait of Hormuz

items.summary_zh: 伊朗说,它正在大力扩大它声称军事控制的霍尔木兹海峡周围地区,以维护它对主要贸易路线的主权。
